cols.name: irrigated share and its square
cols.def: Share of sown area irrigated, from the village survey, with its square so the line can rise and then fall.

cols.name: average farm size
cols.def: Cultivable area divided by the number of farmers, on a log scale.

cols.name: Scheduled Tribe share
cols.def: Share of the population from Scheduled Tribes, census 2011.

cols.name: night lights
cols.def: Night-time brightness seen from satellite, 2023, on a log scale.

cols.name: non-farm businesses
cols.def: Establishments outside farming per 1,000 people, Economic Census 2013.

cols.name: connectivity average
cols.def: Average of standardised shares of villages with a paved road, public transport, a bank and a railway station.

cols.name: state baseline
cols.def: Each state gets its own intercept, so a district is set only against districts in the same state.

cols.name: grouped by 2011 district
cols.def: Districts carved from the same 2011 district are treated as one group when measuring uncertainty.

rows.name: irrigation curve
rows.note: Effective number of crops on irrigated share and its square. Across eight versions of the model and sample the peak runs from 0.245 to 0.513.

rows.name: irrigation source
rows.note: Canal and surface-water shares of villages, groundwater left out as the comparison.

rows.name: single district measures
rows.note: One district measure at a time, first on its own and then holding irrigation and farm size constant within the state baseline.

rows.name: facility comparisons
rows.note: One facility at a time. Benjamini-Hochberg correction across the ten crop categories.

robust.name: without the 64 districts that share a 2011 district
weighted by one over the districts sharing a 2011 district
without districts where the two irrigation sources differ by more than 0.30
